title: A 14-nm Energy-Efficient and Reconfigurable Analog Current-Domain In-Memory Compute SRAM Accelerator
problem: This work presents a low-power reconfigurable 12T-SRAM current-domain analog in-memory computing (IMC) SRAM macro design to address non-linearities, process variations, and limited throughput
method: proposed design features a time-domain subthreshold multiply and accumulate (MAC) operation with a differential output current sensing technique
